items.prompt: An invented service charges 50 per job, variable cost is 30 and fixed costs are 120. Ten jobs occur. Opening cash is 100, receipts are 80 and payments are 230. A later invoice is counted early; safe capacity is five jobs. Give five financial corrections, showing calculations.
items.model_answer: Contribution is 20 per job; ten jobs yield revenue 500, variable cost 300, contribution 200 and simplified surplus 80 before omissions. Current cash is minus 50, excluding later receipts. Break-even is six jobs under base assumptions, above five-job capacity; a cost rise to 35 would make it eight. State omitted mission costs and separate viability, cash and impact. No real borrowing or investment advice.

items.prompt: Develop a conditional enterprise-launch decision across all six SEE courses for an invented repair-and-learning venture. Sales are treated as employment impact; ten comments become guaranteed demand; price and cost assumptions conceal a cash gap; an outside funder controls members; a target reduces learning hours; and expansion is promised before staffing or authority is checked. Compare options, show financial reasoning, preserve mission and specify a bounded review. Use invented records only.
items.model_answer: Integrate mission, payer/user/beneficiary roles and model tensions (078); bounded market evidence, alternatives and a credible accessible offer (079); explicit unit contribution, simplified costs, cash timing, break-even and capacity sensitivity (080); finance obligations, member control, inclusion and regulated-service limits (081); relevant measures, missing outcomes, attribution limits and mission review (082); and coherent options, authority/resource gates, a limited fictional test and continue/modify/pause decision (083). State responsible roles, assumptions and disconfirming evidence. No fundraising, real debts, registration, deposit-taking or service launch through coursework.

items.prompt: Critique an invented claim that a new portal, a cooperative name, positive revenue and a large impact dashboard prove a viable and inclusive enterprise. The claim relies on a sector scoping review as a survival guarantee, a tool usability study as an outcome trial and a 2026 measurement-adoption paper as current local causal evidence. Public review questions are proposed unchanged for a graded exam and certificates are promised after viewing slides. Use all six SEE domains to correct the claims and propose the next authorised step.
items.model_answer: Separate novelty and trading from an evidenced mission mechanism (078); demand from selected interest and a label from a credible offer (079); revenue, contribution, profit, cash and capacity from a complete feasibility conclusion (080); identity, actual member control, financing obligations and access from regulated permission (081); proxies and reporting adoption from beneficiary outcomes, with design/date/context limits and missing results retained (082); and a bounded staged proposal from actual launch or professional authority (083). Public assessment exemplars require unpublished production banks before graded deployment. Badges need verified course passes; certification needs all six approved courses, configured mixed ParaLearn assessment, human written marking, independent moderation and authorised Head of Learning/Founder signatures.
